//: Firestore rules for the shared default DB are owned by BookWare/mysite/firestore.rules (the `routes` collection is defined there). Do NOT add a firestore block here — deploying it would overwrite the shared ruleset.
//csp: Strict CSP on the app page only: android.html / ios.html still use inline <script> blocks. Inline style attributes are allowed because the directions HTML uses them. connect-src covers Groq (AI mode) and Firestore (shared routes); script-src covers the lazily loaded Firebase SDK and the QR library.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://www.gstatic.com https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; connect-src 'self' https://api.groq.com https://firestore.googleapis.com https://*.googleapis.com https://www.gstatic.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
